body.name: Atlas blocked terminal preview
body.body: - Atlas has a new keyboard navigation layout - Atlas has a completely new blocked based terminal - Atlas keeps track of your plans - New plan permission UI for agents

body.name: UI minor patches
body.body:
- The added blur is creating a lag for macos mission control. I swapped this with a Faux-glass depth for perceived depth which restored the macos mission control performance
- The terminal text sometimes overlapped with the fixed header. fixed

body.name: Atlas Source control system
body.body:
- Completely new source control panel
- New Usage panel
- Pomodoro fixed for rendering the same day (wrong date as the current date)
- agent chat UI update
- Blurry panel

body.body: - Atlas had some bugs related to graph view and crashes in KB mode, this build fixes those

body.name: Stable Alpha
body.body:
- Fixes with research paper pull not working with the network tab, works in dev but not in production
- Reference picker is fixed, renders SVG icons
- Claude Code install journey
- Atlas adds `.atlas` in `.gitignore` files

- New Icon
- Lighter build

body.name: Alpha preview for Mac Arm
body.body: Atlas Alpha that only ships ACP support with claude code and reference systems, modules might break, for example the research paper pull doesn't load all the time, there might be some heavy ram usage, things which will eventually improve over time
